review.title: Phase three model implementation & integration review (independent, read-only)

executed_evidence.note: All executions read-only: verify() called directly (never main()), PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 / python -B used throughout; no server started, no HTTP call made, no reference or model bytes touched.

selected_bagging_cross_environment.fixture_source: TRAIN candidate rows only, no student data

full_model_verifier.invoked: scripts.verify_phase_three_models.verify() under .venv/bin/python (main() NOT invoked; reports/phase_three/model_acceptance.json was not written by this review)
full_model_verifier.recorded_acceptance_consistency: reports/phase_three/model_acceptance.json (written upstream after results.json landed) reproduces this independent run exactly: same per-model deltas and artifact sha256 values, runtime .venv/bin/python, clean-env delta 0.0

findings.title: KNN strict replay runtime is recorded, not enforced
findings.detail: verify() replays saved probabilities in-process under whichever interpreter runs the verifier and records probability_replay_runtime instead of asserting it is .venv. KNN float32 cross-build drift (6.38e-7, reports/phase_three/knn_runtime_diagnostic.json) exceeds the 1e-12 tolerance, so running the verifier under .venv-clean would produce a FAILURE, never a false pass. Direction of error is fail-closed; the diagnostic and the acceptance record's executable field give adequate auditability.
findings.recommendation: Optional hardening: when any evaluation family is knn_distance_weighted, require Path(sys.executable).resolve() to be ROOT/.venv/bin/python (or assert against the training run's versions record) so the required runtime is enforced rather than documented.

findings.title: Cross-environment version equality cannot distinguish BLAS distributions
findings.detail: cross_environment_probe requires identical python/numpy/scipy/sklearn/joblib version strings between .venv and .venv-clean, but the KNN diagnostic shows identical versions with different scipy distributions (system vs isolated-wheel) and a 6.38e-7 float32 difference. The 1e-12 probability-delta check still catches any actual divergence, so this remains fail-closed; only the version-equality gate alone would not have been sufficient evidence of numeric identity.
findings.recommendation: Optional: also record/compare BLAS thread configuration and scipy distribution origin in the probe output (informational; the delta check is the real gate).
findings.risk: none to correctness; auditability nuance only

findings.title: Rollback restarts the original environment without re-verifying its health
findings.detail: On any post-write failure the exact original runtime.env is restored atomically and the dedicated API restarted, then RuntimeError is raised. The original environment was already validated healthy earlier in the same run (check_api preflight), and the failure is loud, but the rollback path itself does not confirm the restored service came back healthy before raising.
findings.recommendation: Optional: after rollback, best-effort re-check read_health on 127.0.0.1:8000 against the pre-apply expected values and include the outcome in the raised error text.
findings.risk: low; failure direction is loud, not silent

findings.title: Activation report file is written only on successful --apply
findings.detail: Dry-run prints the report without writing; a failed --apply rolls back and raises without persisting a report artifact, leaving the failed attempt evidenced only in console output.
findings.recommendation: Optional: write the report (with applied:false and failure detail) to a non-default path on failure, keeping the refuse-to-overwrite default path for success.

findings.title: LR fixture replay delta is nonzero but far within tolerance
findings.detail: LogisticRegression replay delta 1.6653345369377348e-15 versus saved probabilities (float64 arithmetic-order variance across processes); tolerance is 1e-12. Both Bagging artifacts and KNN under .venv replay at exactly 0.0.

findings.title: Post-completion hardening edit reviewed
findings.detail: run_phase_three.py was modified at 12:52, after results.json was written at 12:50, adding refuse_existing_stage (fails before loading data or fitting if any stage output already exists, enumerating per-stage outputs including downstream results.json and model_freeze.json) and assert_prediction_identity (validates saved prediction caches against dataset identity keys). Both are fail-closed hardening that prevent stage refits/overwrites; they cannot alter completed artifacts. The independent verifier run performed after this edit passed against the unchanged artifacts (model.joblib sha256 still matches model_freeze.json).
findings.recommendation: none (keep; consider noting the edit time in PROTOCOL.md for provenance clarity)

findings.title: results.json absence during early review was in-flight upstream work
findings.detail: experiments/phase_three/results.json was absent at review start (student stage still running); per instruction this was not treated as a defect. It appeared at 12:50, complete with all four evaluations (three families + bagging_tuned), and the full verifier passes against it.

integrity_statement: This review executed only read-only operations against the repository. No model was fitted outside the sanctioned synthetic unit tests; no server was started or contacted over HTTP; no reference, model, prediction, report, or configuration file was modified. The only file created is analysis/review/phase_three/model_integration_review.json.
